name: dreaming-course-pipeline
description: A dependency-checked agent-handoff workflow that turns weekly materials and bundled Dharawal stories into reviewed, narrative-led teaching decks.

interface.longDescription: Seven linked workflow skills verify Windows or macOS dependencies, use scoped outside-sandbox Office automation, preserve and process sources, require attributed use of the bundled Dharawal story library, review blueprints and images, and assemble and QA PowerPoint decks.
capabilities: Automatic Python and package dependency preflight
Scoped outside-sandbox execution for local Office automation
Local PowerPoint rendering on Windows and macOS
Seven linked course-production skills with agent handoffs
Required attributed use of the bundled Dharawal story library
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $dreaming-course-preflight to verify dependencies and start the automatic Dreaming Course Pipeline from my course materials.
